You are too late, champion of Lordaeron. The dead shall have their day.

Your journey has just begun, young prince. Gather your forces and meet me in the artic land of Northrend. It is there that we shall settle the score between us. It is there that your true destiny will unfold.
You'll never defeat the Lich King without my forces! I'll have my revenge...on him, AND you...
ENOUGH! I waste my time here...I must gather my strength on the home world...
(Eredun) I AM MAL'GANIS! I AM ETERNAL!
I spent too much time in that weak little shell...
Your time has come to an end!
Your death is in vain, tiny mortal...
My onslaught will wash over the Lich King's forces...
It is Prince Arthas I want... not you...

This will be a fine test...Prince Arthas...
As you can see, your people are now mine. I will now turn this city household by household, until the flame of life has been snuffed out... forever.
Yes, this is the beginning. I've been waiting for you, young prince. I am Mal'Ganis.
This is the hour of our greatest triumph!
There is no future for you.
We'll see about that, young prince.
Prince Arthas Menethil, on this day, a powerful darkness has taken hold of your soul. The death you are destined to visit upon others will this day be your own.
Archavon the Stone Watcher goes into a berserker rage!
A Tempest Minion appears to defend Emalon!
Emalon the Storm Watcher overcharges a Tempest Minion!
My demise accomplishes nothing! The Master will have you! You will drown in your own blood! This world shall burn! Aaaghh!
I'll turn your world... upside... down...

Don't look so smug! I know what you're thinking, but Tempest Keep was merely a set back. Did you honestly believe I would trust the future to some blind, half-night elf mongrel? Oh no, he was merely an instrument, a stepping stone to a much larger plan! It has all led to this, and this time, you will not interfere!
One is such a lonely number.
I could have sworn there were more of you.
Not really much of a group, anymore, is it?
I call that a good start.
Lackies be damned! I'll finish you myself!
No! More... I must have more!
%s begins to channel from the nearby Fel Crystal...
Blessed ancestors! I feel it... so much love... so much grace... there are... no words... impossible to describe...
Our arrogance was unpardonable. We damned one of the most noble beings of all. We may never atone for this sin.
Salvation, young one. It waits for us all.
In time, the light and hope held within - will rebirth more than this mere fount of power... Mayhap, they will rebirth the soul of a nation.
Gaze now, mortals - upon the HEART OF M'URU! Unblemished. Bathed by the light of Creation - just as it was at the Dawn.
Then fortunate it is, that I have reclaimed the noble naaru's spark from where it fell! Where faith dwells, hope is never lost, young blood elf.

The creature Entropius, whom you were forced to destroy, was once the noble naaru, M'uru. In life, M'uru channeled vast energies of LIGHT and HOPE. For a time, a misguided few sought to steal those energies...

As the Legion's final defeat draws ever-nearer, stand proud in the knowledge that you have saved worlds without number from the flame. Just as this day marks an ending, so too does it herald a new beginning...

Mortal heroes, your victory here today was foretold long ago. My brother's anguished cry of defeat will echo across the universe, bringing renewed hope to all those who still stand against the Burning Crusade.
I have channeled all I can! The power is in your hands!
Another orb is ready! Make haste!
I have empowered another orb! Use it quickly!
I will channel my power into the orbs, be ready!
You are not alone. The Blue Dragonflight shall help you vanquish the Deceiver.
Strike now, heroes, while he is weakened! Vanquish the Deceiver!
Goodbye, Anveena, my love. Few will remember your name, yet this day you change the course of destiny. What was once corrupt is now pure. Heroes, do not let her sacrifice be in vain.
The nightmare is over, the spell is broken! Goodbye, Kalec, my love!
Yes, Anveena! Let fate embrace you now!
Anveena, I love you! Focus on my voice, come back for me now! Only you can cleanse the Sunwell!
But I'm... lost... I cannot find my way back!
You must let go! You must become what you were always meant to be! The time is now, Anveena!
I serve only the Master now.
Anveena, you must awaken, this world needs you!
Do not harbor false hope. You cannot win!
Aggghh! The powers of the Sunwell... turned... against me! What have you done? WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?
I will not be denied! This world shall fall!

The expendible have perished... So be it! Now I shall succeed where Sargeras could not! I will bleed this wretched world and secure my place as the true master of the Burning Legion. The end has come! Let the unraveling of this world commence!
Drain the girl! Drain her power until there is nothing but a vacant shell!
Fail me and suffer for eternity!
Stay on task! Do not waste time!
All my plans have led to this!
Time is a luxury you no longer possess!
Alythess! Your fire burns within me!
Shadow to the aid of fire!
Your luck has run its curse!
Fire to the aid of shadow!
Madrigosa deserved a far better fate. You did what had to be done, but this battle is far from over.
I am stronger than ever before!
No more hesitation! Your fates are written!
Glory to Kil'jaeden! Death to all who oppose!
Malygos, my lord! I did my best!
Speak, I grow weary of asking!
You will tell me where they are!
Where is Anveena, demon? What has become of Kalec?
Gah! Well done... Now... this gets... interesting...
Hold, friends! There is information to be had before this devil meets his fate!
So much for a real challenge... Die!
Ahh! More lambs to the slaughter!
Haven't you heard? I always win!
I have toyed with you long enough!
Puny lizard! Death is the only answer you'll find here!
I'm... never on... the losing... side...
There will be no reprieve. My work here is nearly finished.
I am forever in your debt. Once we have triumphed over Kil'jaeden, this entire world will be in your debt as well.
Hurry! There is not much of me left!
Aaahhh! Help me, before I lose my mind!
I need... your help... Cannot... resist him... much longer...
My awakening is complete! You shall all perish!
Aggh! No longer will I be a slave to Malygos! Challenge me and you will be destroyed!
A taste... just a small taste... of the Spell-Weaver's power!
Still you fight. Still you cling to misguided principles. If you survive, you'll find me in the center ring.
Clearly my pets failed. Perhaps another demonstration is in order.

What do we have here... those that would defy the Spell-Weaver? Those without foresight our understanding. How can i make you see? Malygos is saving the world from itself! Bah! You are hardly worth my time!
Finish it! FINISH IT! Kill me, or I swear by the Dragonqueen you'll never see daylight again!
Now we've come to the truth!
Preserve? Why? There's no truth in it. No no no... only in the taking! I see that now!
I'll give you more than you can handle.
There's plenty of me to go around.
You know what they say about curiosity.
Tor of the Brutal Siege! Bestow your might upon me!
Ranulf of the Screaming Abyss, snuff these maggots with darkest night!
Bjorn of the Black Storm! Honor me now with your presence!
Haldor of the Rocky Cliffs, grant me your strength!
There is a reason I am king!
Your death is only the beginning!
You invade my home and then dare to challenge me? I will tear the hearts from your chests and offer them as gifts to the death god! Rualg nja gaborr!
Nooo! I did not come this far... to...
Your will is done, my king.
You were a fool to challenge the power of the Lich King!
I will be happy to slaughter them in your name! Come, enemies of the Scourge! I will show you the might of the Lich King!
The sensation is... beyond my imagining. I am yours to command, my king.
My liege! I have done as you asked, and now beseech you for your blessing!
Cleanse our sacred halls with flame!
Go now! Leave nothing but ash in your wake!
You motherless knaves! Your corpses will make fine morsels for my new drake!
%s in within range of the harpoon launchers!
ARGH! You call that... an attack? I'll... show... aghhhh...
%s in within range of the harpoon launchers!
I'll mount your skull from the highest tower!
Not so brash now, are you?
What mongrels dare intrude here? Look alive, my brothers! A feast for the one that brings me their heads!
What this place? I will destroy you!
You die! That what master wants!
Skarvald, you incompetent slug! Return and make yourself useful!
By all means, don't assess the situation, you halfwit! Just jump into the fray!
Pagh! What sort of necromancer lets death stop him? I knew you were worthless!
Dalronn! See if you can muster the nerve to join my attack!
No! I can do... better! I can...
My life for the... death god!
I return! A second chance to carve out your skull!
I'll paint my face with your blood!
Aranal, lidel! Their fate shall be yours!
I suppose this is it, then? I won't go down quietly!
You don't know who you're messing with! Death beckons!
Finally! This charade is over... Arthas give me strength!
Do you fell that folks? The air is cracking with energy! Than can only mean one thing...
Stinkbeard comin' for you, little ones!
Your're right! What was I thinking? Bring on the Scourge!
Your're right! We can do this!
We'll cleanse this place! Arthas beware!
The battle is about to begin! Am I reading this card right It... It's the nefarious magnataur lord, STINKBEARD! Yes, folks, STINKBEARD! Chitchat dosen't stand a chance!
Hailling from the distant mountains of Alterac, one of the fiercest competitors this arena has ever seen: KORRAK THE BLOODRAGER!!!
The champion of the Winterax trolls has challenged you, Treeofdoom! I hope you're ready!
Whisker! Where are you? Assist me!

This battle must be seen to be believed! Once a mild-mannered tuskarr fisherman, our next fighter turned to the life of a soulless mercenary when his entire family was wiped out by a vicious pack of lion seals and III-tempered penguins! Now he's just In It for the gold! Ladies and gentlemen, ORINOKO TUSKBREAKER!!
Noooo! This tortue is inhumane! You have what you want... why don't you just kill me?
I've given you the information, $C ! You're wasting your time....
Alright! I am beaten. Your previous archmage is held in a prison, elevated and sealed. Even if you manage to reach her, Salrand herself holds the key. Your mission is folly!
Stop! I beg you, please stop. Please...
Aahhhh! Release me! I am of no use to you. I swear it!
Aargh! Do your worst, $C ! I'll tell you NOTHING!
Pathetic fool! A servant of malygos would sooner die than aid an emeny...
Do not worry, Leryssa. I will come back to you when I'm done. Nothing in the world will stop me from coming home to the only family that I have left.
I know that look in your eye... I'm not going to be able to talk you out of this. If you die on me again...
You might be right, sister. My obligations to my land and King have been fulfilled. But there is still something that I owe to myself.
Don't leave me again! You want to fight for your country, but they don't even want you! They sent you here to die!
I cannot return home with you just yet, Leryssa. I am not quite done with the Scourge.
I thought... I thought you were... dead.
Ugh! My head won't stop spinning...
Do not fail me, San'layn. Return to Icecrown with this fool's head or do not bother to return.
Allow me to take care of the intruders, lord. I will feed their entrails to the maggots.
I would sooner slit my own throat. You will pay for what you did to your own men, Arthas... for what you did to me! I swear it.
Now this is a surprise, Thassarian. I hadn't heard from Mograine or the other death knights for months. You've come to rejoin the Scourge, I take it?
What have you done to my sister, you motherless elf scum!?
The power you've bestowed upon me has allowed me great mental influence over human minds. I bear these offerings as proof of my progress.
Your progress in this region has been impressive, Blood Prince. I am pleased...
My liege, the infiltration and control of the Alliance power structure by our cultists is well underway.
I'm not afraid of anything -- bring it on!
Let me know when you ready to go, okay?
You save me! We thank you. We going to go back to village now. You come too... you can stay with us! Puppy-men kind of mean anyway.
I... be waitin' on da udda side....
Mua-ha-ha! Now whatchoo got to say?
You had your chance, now it be too late!
You call on da beast, you gonna get more dan you bargain for!
Don't be delayin' your fate. Come to me now. I make your sacrifice quick.
What could be better than servin' da bear spirit for eternity? Come closer now. Bring your souls to me!
I be losin' me patience! Go on: make dem wish dey was never born!
Ride now! Ride out dere and bring me back some heads!
Guards, go already! Who you more afraid of, dem... or me?
Get da move on, guards! It be killin' time!
Come, friends. Your bodies gonna feed ma hatchlings, and your souls are going to feed me with power!
Come, strangers. The spirit of the dragonhawk hot be hungry for worthy souls.
Zul'jin... got a surprise for you...
It all be over now, mon!
I show you strength... in numbers.
Where ma hatcha? Get to work on dem eggs!
Spirits of da wind be your doom!
You won't kill next one so easy!
Gronn are the real power in outland.
You will not defeat the hand of Gruul!
You're not caught up for this!
You wish to kill me? Hahaha, you first!
Common... such a crude language. Bandal!
I have better things to do...
Be careful what you wish for...
Yes... you'll stay with us now...
You can have anything you desire... for a price.
I don't want to go back!
Look at what you make me do!
Pain and suffering are all that await you!
YOU WILL SHOW THE PROPER RESPECT!
I was the first, you know. For me, the wheel of death has spun many times. <laughs> So much time has passed. I have a lot of catching up to do...
I'll rip the meat from your bones!
Drink your blood! Eat your flesh!
So much for a happy ending.
Come out from the shadows! I've returned to lead you against our true enemy! Shed your chains and raise your weapons against your Illidari masters!
I will not last much longer...
The ground begins to crack open!
My patience has ran out! Die, DIE!
You will die in the name of Lady Vashj!
I will not waste this chance. I will seek out my destiny.
Thank you, strangers. You have given me hope.
I did not ask for this!
I am truly in your debt, strangers.
It should not have come to this!
Blackmoore has much to answer for!
I am a slave no longer!
This day is long overdue. Out of my way!
I will fight to the last!
Goodbye, Taretha. I will never forget your kindness.
Taretha! What foul magic is this?
Taretha must be in the inn. Let's go.
Very well. Tarren Mill lies just west of here. Since time is of the essence...
As long as we're going with a new plan, I may aswell pick up a weapon and some armor.
No!...The master... will not... be pleased.
Struggle as much as you like!
Thrall will remain a slave. Taretha will die. You have failed.
Enough! I will erase your very existence!

Ah, there you are. I had hoped to accomplish this with a bit of subtlety, but I suppose direct confrontation was inevitable. Your future, Thrall, must not come to pass and so...you and your troublesome friends must die!
Taretha's life hangs in the balance. Surely you care for her. Surely you wish to save her...
Thrall! Come outside and face your fate!
I know what you're up to, and I mean to put an end to it, permanently!
You there, fetch water quickly! Get these flames out before they spread to the rest of the keep! Hurry, damn you!
Did you really think you would leave here alive?
I don't know what Blackmoore sees in you. For my money, you're just another ignorant savage!
You're a slave. That's all you'll ever be.
Thrall! You didn't really think you would escape did you? You and your allies shall answer to Blackmoore - after I've had my fun!
These walls will be your doom.
